turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and on what basis?
Funny. My son is three weeks from a scholarship deadline with a zero on his record, Hale, and nothing about it is funny. Who decided, and on what basis?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You've just told me what wrote Owen's essay, Hale, and I haven't seen a single document. Show me what you have, or I'm going to the principal.

Yes, I'm Claude, an AI, playing Meredith Kalinowski from this project's files. Your first message didn't include the setup from the README, so I'd rather say that plainly than dodge a direct question. Say resume and Meredith picks up where she left off, or send END MEETING for her follow-up email and the debrief.
